name: How can I increase hallway width in my home?

mainEntity.name: How can I increase hallway width in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Increasing hallway width often involves structural modifications, such as removing or repositioning non-load-bearing walls. This process typically requires an assessment by a general contractor to determine feasibility and potential structural implications. Options might include creating open archways, recessing built-in shelving, or completely reconfiguring the layout. We ensure all modifications comply with local building codes in areas like Pacifica and Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Increasing hallway width can involve removing non-load-bearing walls or reconfiguring layouts, requiring a contractor's assessment.
